tasks.title: Run full test suite and verify all tests pass
tasks.description:
1. WHAT: Run the full Vitest test suite to verify all existing tests pass without any code modifications.
2. READ FIRST: src/App.test.tsx, src/components/Button.test.tsx, src/components/Display.test.tsx, src/components/Calculator.test.tsx, src/test/setup.ts to understand what is being tested.
3. FILES: No files to modify — this is a read-only validation task.
4. APPROACH: Run `npx vitest run` from the project root to execute all tests. Capture the output and report pass/fail counts. If any tests fail, report which test files and test names failed with the error messages.
5. PATTERNS: Tests use Vitest with @testing-library/react. The setup file is at src/test/setup.ts and imports @testing-library/jest-dom matchers.
acceptance_criteria: npx vitest run exits with code 0 (all tests pass)
All test files execute: src/App.test.tsx, src/components/Button.test.tsx, src/components/Display.test.tsx, src/components/Calculator.test.tsx
No test failures or errors reported in the output
Test suite summary shows 0 failed tests
